note: Fitness and rider training (Spec 3.1, 3.3; Boss 29 and 30 Oct 2026). The gate drop drill (Starts) is offered at the backyard loop (venue): it only gets easier, as if the gate dropped slower, from Starts 70 on (core/training.ts). Each drill is a round of about 40 seconds that can't be failed: finishing it gives its xp whatever the score (Spec 3, Round 122). 50 XP a round is about Tier 1's 4,500 XP an hour (Spec 2.2). walk: Agility for walking about, xp every `tiles` tiles.

drills.name: Bodyweight drills
drills.how: Press Space or tap as the marker crosses the green zone for a good rep. Every round counts, whatever your reps.

drills.name: Gate drop drill
drills.how: Your front wheel at the gate. Watch the gate: press Space or tap the moment it drops. Too early is a jumped start, too late a slow one. Every round counts.

drills.name: Weight training
drills.how: Press Space or tap as the marker crosses the green zone for a clean lift. Tier 2: every round counts, whatever you lift.

drills.name: Body position drills
drills.how: Attack position over the bumps: press Space or tap as the marker crosses the green zone to get forward at the right moment.

drills.name: Cone braking
drills.how: Hold Space or press and hold to carry speed, let go to brake. Keep the marker in the green band through each cone.

drills.name: Rut riding
drills.how: Watch the rut: press Space or tap the moment the front wheel drops in. Early and you wash out, late and you cross-rut.

drills.name: Agility ladder
drills.how: Hold Space or press and hold to quicken your feet, let go to settle. Keep the marker in the green band down the ladder. Tier 3: every round counts.

drills.name: Jump timing
drills.how: Watch the take-off: press Space or tap at the lip. Early and you case it, late and you overjump. Big Pete calls the whips once the timing is in.

drills.name: Whoops and sand
drills.how: Hold Space or press and hold to skim the whoops, let go to settle. Keep the marker in the green band and the front wheel light.

drills.name: Yoga session
drills.how: Press Space or tap as the marker crosses the green zone to hold each pose on the breath. Tier 3: every round counts.

drills.name: Berm and flat corner
drills.how: Hold Space or press and hold to carry speed into the berm, let go to brake for the flat turn. Keep the marker in the green band.

drills.name: Ruts over roots
drills.how: Watch the root: press Space or tap the moment the front wheel meets it. Early and you deflect, late and you stall in the rut.

drills.name: Rowing session
drills.how: Hold Space or press and hold to pull harder, let go to ease off. Keep the stroke rate in the green band for each split. Tier 3.

drills.name: Rock garden
drills.how: Watch the rock: press Space or tap as the front wheel lifts over it. Early and you stall, late and you bash the bash plate.

drills.name: Shadow passing
drills.how: Hold Space or press and hold to close on the pro ahead, let go before you tag his back wheel. Keep the gap in the green band and make the pass.

drills.name: Hill climb ride
drills.how: Hold Space or press and hold to push on the climb, let go to recover. Keep your effort in the green band to the top. Tier 4: every round counts.

drills.name: Repetition laps
drills.how: Press Space or tap as the marker crosses the green zone at every lap split: the same lap, every lap.

drills.name: Dojo session
drills.how: Press Space or tap as the marker crosses the green zone to land each strike on the count. Tier 4: every round counts.

drills.name: Supercross rhythm
drills.how: Press Space or tap as the marker crosses the green zone on every take-off of the rhythm section: double, triple, double.

drills.name: Drag launch
drills.how: Watch the lights on the No-Turn strip: press Space or tap the moment they go green. Early is a jumped start, late is a lost one.

drills.name: Ice bath recovery
drills.how: Hold Space or press and hold to breathe slow and stay under, let go to come up. Keep your breathing in the green band. Tier 5: every round counts.

drills.name: Pro jump timing
drills.how: Tier 5: press Space or tap at the lip of every take-off on the national track. The window is tight.

drills.name: Pro gate drop
drills.how: Tier 5: the national gate. Press Space or tap the moment it drops. Nothing gets easier here.

drills.name: Running session
drills.how: Hold Space or press and hold to run faster, let go to ease off. Keep your pace in the green band for each lap split.
